title: HATS common definitions
description: Shared sub-schemas referenced by the agent template, deployed agent and project schemas.

hatType.description: De Bono thinking hat worn by an agent. 'none' means the agent has no hat-driven bias.

hatList.description: One or more hats. Multiple hats are merged into a blended directive set.

providerName.description: LLM provider adapter id. 'external' delegates the agent to an out-of-process runner such as Claude Code.

identity.description: Everything that gives an agent a face, a voice and a personality.

visualDescription.description: Short prose description of how the agent presents itself.

specialisation.description: Domain expertise shown in the team roster, e.g. 'financial analysis'.

backstory.description: Biography injected into the system prompt.

email.description: Agent's own address, used as the From address for email MCP servers.

avatar.description: GLB filename from the avatar catalogue, e.g. 'morgan.glb'.

speakerName.description: Speaker within a multi-speaker voice model.

modelBinding.description: Which LLM answers for this agent.

limits.description: Runtime guard rails. Omitted fields fall back to engine defaults.

maxContextTokens.description: History is trimmed to stay under this estimate. Defaults to the model context window.

maxCostPerHour.description: USD/hour. The agent idles until the next hour once exceeded.

toolAccess.description: Which MCP servers the agent may reach.

enabledMcpServers.description: Shared MCP server ids. Absent means 'every server enabled for the team'.

disabledPersonalMcpServers.description: Personal MCP servers that have credentials stored but are currently stopped.

upfrontTools.description: MCP tools shown to the model in every call instead of being found with search_tools. An entry is a server id ('email-imap') or one tool ('email-imap:get_email'). Absent means every personal server; an empty list means none.

mcpServerDefinition.description: A shared MCP server attached to a project team.

slug.description: Filesystem-safe identifier. Doubles as a folder name, so path separators and dots are excluded; spaces and capitals are allowed because existing project folders use them.

identifier.description: A stable identity. Usually a generated UUID, but a well-known constant such as 'builtin-claude-code' is also valid.

externalEndpoint.description: How to reach an agent whose provider is 'external' — a subprocess or HTTP runner outside this process. Passed through verbatim to the runner that understands it.

error.description: Uniform error body returned by every HATS service.
